sloka: किमेतदेवं सुविनिश्चितं ते यद्राघवे नासि कृतानुकम्पः।पश्याद्य मद्बाहुबलाभिभूतो विकीर्णमात्मानमथो नगेन्द्र ।। ६.७४.६६ ।।
transliteration: kimetadevaṁ suviniścitaṁ te yadrāghave nāsi kṛtānukampaḥ।paśyādya madbāhubalābhibhūto vikīrṇamātmānamatho nagendra ।। 6.74.66 ।।

translations.english: Seizing hold of the peaks vehemently, its trees, elephants, gold mines withthousands of minerals he crushed the projections and set fire and burnt and uprooted swiftly.
